mapper.select: SELECT d.PERIOD_YM AS periodYm, SUBSTR(d.PERIOD_YM,3,2) || '.' || SUBSTR(d.PERIOD_YM,5,2) AS monthLabel, d.SR_CLS AS srCls, NVL(c.CD_NM, d.SR_CLS) AS srClsName, SUM(d.SR_CNT) AS srCnt, NVL(SUM(d.JOB_MM), 0) AS jobMm FROM DASH_DEV_AGG d LEFT JOIN HR_DEVELOPER h ON d.EMPNO = h.EMPNO LEFT JOIN CD_COMMON c ON c.GRP_CD = 'SR_CLS' AND c.CD_VAL = d.SR_CLS WHERE d.PERIOD_YM >= #{fromYm} AND NVL(h.DEPT_CD, '미분류') = #{unitId} AND NVL(h.DEPT_CD, '미분류') || '-' || NVL(h.PART_CD, '미분류') = #{unitId} AND d.EMPNO = #{unitId} GROUP BY d.PERIOD_YM, d.SR_CLS, c.CD_NM ORDER BY d.PERIOD_YM, d.SR_CLS
SELECT h.DEPT_CD AS deptCd, h.PART_CD AS partCd FROM HR_DEVELOPER h WHERE h.EMPNO = #{empno}
